title: Stock Prediction ML
description: Time-series machine learning model analyzing equities with predictive volatility curves and Streamlit dashboard.

caseStudy.tagline: Time-series machine learning model analyzing equities with predictive volatility curves and Streamlit dashboard.

problem.headline: Building robust feature pipelines for non-stationary financial time series.
problem.description: Financial market data suffers from low signal-to-noise ratios and regime shifts. Standard regressions often overfit historical data without providing actionable confidence bands.

architecture.headline: Walk-forward rolling validation with technical indicator feature pipelines.
architecture.description: Implemented rolling time-series splits to prevent future data leakage, extracting momentum, volatility, and mean-reversion indicators before training gradient-boosted ensembles.

highlights.title: Leakage-Free Feature Engineering
highlights.detail: Strict lag transforms ensuring zero lookahead bias during feature computation.

highlights.title: Interactive Volatility Bands
highlights.detail: Streamlit dashboard rendering confidence envelopes alongside historical moving averages.

features.title: Predictive Price Curve
features.description: Ensemble model projection with adjustable forecast horizons and risk boundaries.

features.title: Technical Indicator Matrix
features.description: Automated calculation of MACD, RSI, and exponential moving averages.

takeaways: In financial machine learning, leak-free validation architecture is vastly more important than tuning complex model hyperparameters.
